texts.a4ffe9537cfe: The aim of the study is to determine effect on mortality from breast cancer of mammographic screening in woman starting at ages 40-41, compared with starting at age 50 as in the currant national breast screening programme. Interim analyses will use details on pathology of all breast cancers diagnosed in the trial population to predict outcomes.
texts.a6b05b1a5220: The data supplied by NHS IC to the Institute of Cancer Research will be used only for the approved Medical Research Project identified above.
